quarterly_data.quarter: Planet Labs press release: Planet Awarded NASA Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planet's subsidiary Planet Labs Federal was awarded an evaluation task order under NASA's Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition (CSDA) program: NASA will acquire Tanager hyperspectral data covering more than 250,000 square kilometers (recent archive and newly tasked coverage) and evaluate its quality, reliability and utility for Earth science (Level 1C and Level 2A products; Tanager measures more than 400 contiguous spectral channels at 30-meter resolution); NASA's final report will help inform decisions to make Tanager data available to the federally funded scientific community. Tanager-2, launched October 1, 2026, captured its first light image a week after launch, detecting its first methane plume over Spain's Costa Blanca; the U.S. Geological Survey is separately evaluating the Tanager constellation's on-orbit performance and calibration accuracy.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 250,000 square kilometers of Tanager data
